source: ClassPad.net Math - exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-20 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project.
notes: All expected full LCD pixels/status indicators were observed on the exact fx-880BTG PLUS in ClassPad, 20 November 2026. All 64 observations accepted without masks or referenceOnly exclusions; JSON saved directly into the project.

Local cursor height follows the last structured item rather than the height of an earlier left-hand side. Nested powers reserve their terminal padding; tall radicals with padded child templates retain two right pixels before the next item. These rules fix full input/result layouts for nested Verify expressions.

Scalar PLUS Verify compares exact rational/radical values with a strict relative threshold |L-R| < max(|L|,|R|)*1e-18. Other numerical functions use the same threshold with the current evaluator values. The legacy 580 ten-digit comparison is unchanged; no per-expression or per-case calibration table.

Discriminating native comparisons: 1=1+1e-18 is False, 1=1+1e-19 is True; +/-9e-19 around 1 compare equal. 3 vs 3+2e-18 is True, 3 vs 3+4e-18 is False; 9 vs 9+8e-18 is True, 9 vs 9+1e-17 is False; 10 vs 10+9e-18 is True, 10 vs 10+1e-17 is False. Probe IDs containing round are retained from exploration; they do not imply display-digit rounding.

Near-threshold not-equal and less-than are False; less-than at 1e-18 difference is True. 1/3=0.3333333333 and sqrt(2)=1.414213562 are False, whereas sqrt(2)*sqrt(2)=2 is True. False stores Ans=0. Underflow and nonzero 1e-99 controls distinguish zero handling.

Rational-side arithmetic retains the existing PLUS operation/underflow profile: (3+2e-18)-3=0 is False, (1+9e-19)-1=0 is True. sin(37)^2+cos(37)^2=1 and tan(37)=sin(37)/cos(37) are True. Displayed-decimal sin(1) comparison and independently stored 15-digit sine/cosine approximations are False.

No Operator with a high exponent returns to input and accepts an inserted relation. Syntax ERROR in a missing denominator returns to the empty slot in the failing side, allowing repair without retyping. English labels and Fix 1 preserve correct False outcomes.

Native input/result pairs cover fraction squares, sqrt(1/2)=sqrt(2)/2, 2^(3^2)=512, absolute radicals, reciprocals and fractional root indices. Numeric/format expectations are native observations, not independently calculated replacements.
